## Description

Adversarial network training both supervised and unsupervised losses in a latent space to generate synthetic, autoregressive financial time-series.

## Where it may fit

Stress-testing rare tail-risk regimes, data augmentation for deep RL model training, and scenario generation under low-sample environments.

## Vehicles

Quantitative risk management groups, systematic CTA funds, multi-strategy hedge funds.

## Required data

Multivariate historical pricing, volume, macroeconomic indicators, and implied volatility surfaces.

## Caveats

GAN training can suffer from mode collapse; generated distributions must be strictly validated against empirical stylized facts (fat tails, leverage effect).
